name: notediscovery-mcp-server
description: NoteDiscovery is a self-hosted plain-markdown notes app (MIT, no telemetry) with a built-in stdio MCP server. The server exposes tools so AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.) can search, read, create, edit, tag, and instantiate templates against the same vault the web UI uses.
